findings: No archived coherent-versus-self intermediate field-scattering task was found. Nonreciprocal-cavity matches coherent scattering text but tests emission/absorption matrices, not thermal displacement dynamics.

Phonon transport treats branch momentum-relaxation constraints, not coherent density scattering. Paired resonators treats quantum canonical normalization. Both are different approximations despite normal-mode machinery.

Hardcore coherence and triad photon phase concern quantum operator/statistics or internal-state permutation phases. Here the particles and Gibbs dynamics are classical, and the wrong step is a collective/self temporal-relaxation closure.

Single-file memory also has an exact calibration subspace and different two-time correlations, but its rank-conserving Brownian preparation and nonstationary increments differ from this stationary harmonically coupled optical array.
Quenched-versus-renewed disorder transport was rejected after reading fixed-trap-memory-r1: it is an exact previously evaluated mechanism, not a new candidate.
